lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spot clusters arranged in a repetitive staggered grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a nodal grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal linear feature in the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast vertical gradient (upper illumination, lower shadow).

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the visible surface of the pectoral fin.
